title: Chapter 289 Returning To The Xiao Clan
content:
Chapter 289 Returning To The Xiao Clan

At this time, Chu Lingsheng stood in an inconspicuous place, and his eyes were filled with shock and curiosity when he looked at Lu Xue.

What is the origin of the ancient Xiao clan leader who can personally welcome him and even give him a tribute.

What level is this ancient Xiao clan?

Even in the declining moments, except for the ancient tribes of the same level who dared to provoke them, no force dared to say anything.

Not to mention the Xiao clan who is now at its peak.

The twelve peak existences in the clan can scare a lot of people to death.

But now, when the leader of the Xiao clan faced Lu Xue, he put his posture very low.

More importantly, Lu Xue did not feel inappropriate about this.

Although Lu Xue was easy-going, Chu Lingsheng could still see it.

"Lu Xue, not only are you not simple in your strength, but you didn't expect that even your background is so mysterious."

At this moment, he suddenly thought of the oath.

Lord of the Huangcheng City?

Could it be that Lu Xue has any connection with the Lord of the Huangcheng City?

Yes, both of them have the surname Lu, can they be a family?

This suspicion appeared in Chu Lingsheng's mind for a moment, and was denied by Chu Lingsheng again.

If there is such a terrifying existence at home, will you go to Tiandi Academy or run like this outside?

Anyway, if it were him, he would definitely not.

Just as Chu Lingsheng was still thinking, a cry suddenly pulled him back to reality.

"Hey, let's go!"

Qin Feng greeted Chu Lingsheng.

I saw that Lu Xue and others had been welcomed into the Xiao clan by Xiao Mo.

Seeing this, Chu Lingsheng no longer thought about it and hurriedly followed.

"Who is this?"

When Xiao Mo saw Chu Lingsheng, his expression did not change, but he immediately returned to normal.

"Grandpa, this is from my academy, um, senior, and the existence on the list of monsters."

"Is the evil list?"

Xiao Mo smiled lightly, with no surprise on his face.

At this time, Chu Lingsheng stepped forward and clasped his fists and said, "My younger Chu Lingsheng, I have met the leader of the Xiao clan."

Not everyone is Lu Xue.

No matter how talented he is, he still has not grown up.

When I see the leader of the Xiao clan, I still have to salute me.

"Chu Lingsheng, I have heard of it a little."

Xiao Mo still smiled faintly.

Upon hearing this, Chu Lingsheng's expression remained unchanged, "It's all just a false reputation."

Looking at Chu Lingsheng, Xiao Mo finally asked the question he cared about the most, "Are you friends with Miss Lu?"

Hearing this question, Chu Lingsheng was slightly stunned.

Looking at Lu Xue, I saw that Lu Xue was also looking at him at this moment.

Lu Xue gave Chu Lingsheng a look, Chu Lingsheng was silent for a moment, and shook his head slightly.

"no."

As soon as he finished speaking, a powerful aura overflowed from Xiao Mo's body and pointed directly at Chu Lingsheng.

"Then you won't meet in your true form."

Xiao Mo said with a smile.

For a moment, the atmosphere suddenly became depressed.

If you hadn't seen that you were with Miss Lu and dared to talk to me with a clone, I would have slapped you to death.

The evil list, so what about the evil list?

My Xiao clan even topped the previous monster list, what a bluff!

Feeling the oppression, Chu Lingsheng's face looked a little ugly. Obviously, the leader of the Xiao clan did not give him face.

But I think so, with the current strength of the Xiao clan, there is basically no need to give face to the entire fairy world.

In comparison, Lu Xue's background seems to be even more terrifying.

"It's the younger generation who is abrupt."

A voice came from a distance, and a somewhat sick man appeared in everyone's sight.

The man looked similar to Chu Lingsheng in front of everyone, but he was more energetic.

This is Chu Lingsheng's true body.

Buzz —

At this time, the "Chu Lingsheng" in front of everyone slowly dissipated and turned into a stream of energy and penetrated into Chu Lingsheng's body.

"You guys are really good at such an age."

Looking at Chu Lingsheng in front of him, Xiao Mo narrowed his eyes and chuckled.

"Class Xiao is so praising. Compared to Senior Xiao Yin, the junior's achievements are nothing."

Hearing this, Xiao Mo laughed and said nothing.

really.

If it were compared with Xiao Yin, it would be nothing.

After a while, under Xiao Mo's leadership, everyone entered the Xiao clan.

It can be seen from the naked eye that the Xiao clan at this time and the Xiao clan when Lu Xue first came, there was a huge change.

Especially the expression of the Xiao clan leader.

That was almost all of a confident look on his face.

The fairy spirit in the Xiao clan also became very strong, and a large number of temples stood in the Xiao clan.

The entire Xiao clan is thriving.

"Miss Lu, the Xiao clan is still a loss to you and Ling Zun now."

Looking at the Xiao clan, Xiao Mo couldn't help but sigh.

Only Lu Xue could hear this.

Lu Xue just smiled at this.

At that time, she almost smashed the strange stone in the Xiao clan's ancestral land.

If it weren't for my father's arrival.

I guess I'm going to have a bad thing again.

Thinking of this, Lu Xue sighed in her heart, not knowing what her father is doing now.

"Grandpa, we're in a hurry, so let's talk about business."

At this time, Xiao Luo stepped forward and said.

Immediately, Xiao Luo told Xiao Mo about his desire to enter the ancient battlefield.

"You want to enter the ancient battlefield?"

Lu Xue and others nodded.

"Grandpa, we want to quickly improve our strength and enter the ancient battlefield, which is undoubtedly the best choice."

Hearing this, Xiao Mo pondered for a moment, and finally nodded.

"With your current strength, you can really have some self-protection ability when you enter the ancient battlefield."

"But now there are many things within the clan. I can't get away with it for the time being, so the elder will take you there."

As soon as he finished speaking, a figure appeared in front of everyone.

It is the great elder of the Xiao clan, Xiao Jing.

"Miss Lu, don't be fine."

Xiao Jing said with a smile.

When Lu Xue saw Xiao Jing, she was also a little surprised. It took only how long it took for Xiao Jing to change so much.

When I first met Xiao Jing, Xiao Jing was still in his twilight posture, with his hair fifty years old.

But now, it seems like a rebirth, I am much younger, and more importantly, my breath has become stronger.

"Senior Xiao Jing."

Lu Xue nodded and responded.

"Grandpa, then let's go."

After Xiao Luo finished speaking, he was about to turn around.

At this time, Xiao Mo said, "Luoer, after entering the ancient battlefield, you must be more careful."

"Remember to follow Miss Lu."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo nodded heavily.

"Grandpa, I've recorded it."

Immediately, Xiao Jing waved his hand, took the four of them, stood up and left.

Halfway.

Xiao Jing introduced the situation on the ancient battlefield to everyone.

"The ancient battlefield is full of killing aura, and there are even more unwilling will left by countless powerful people back then. It will not disperse for a long time. Because of the huge number, the strong people from the outside cannot enter the ancient battlefield. Once they forcefully enter, they will It will arouse the chaotic energy in the ancient battlefield, and then the entire ancient battlefield will be destroyed."

"I can only send you outside. If something happens inside, we can do nothing."

Xiao Mo explained.

Everyone also understood.

In the ancient battlefield, only those under the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm can enter.

Once you reach the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm, very bad consequences will occur.

So this ancient battlefield is mainly used to train the younger generation.

Back then, it was not only the younger generation.

For example, some people who cannot reach the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm will also enter the search for opportunities for breakthroughs.
